title: Do not miss Alhambra!
text: It’s a lot of walking but well worth it as Alhambra is a wonder ! Antonio was probably the best guide I have ever had. His knowledge and warmth were always apparent!
author: nancy_n

title: Day in the Alhambra
text: I went with my mother to see the Alhambra as we had not been there for some time, we decided to choose our experience with them and it was great, we enjoyed a lot with the guide, very funny and friendly throughout the tour, learning a lot about the Alhambra, we will repeat for sure.
author: S8JMlucial

title: Guide to the Alhambra
text: I am a girl from Granada living in Madrid and I took the opportunity to see the Alhambra on a tour of my city and I flip the visit, I enjoyed it very much and I was able to reconnect with my city in the best place of all

title: Alhambra
text: We went from Gijon to Granada and took the opportunity to visit the Alhambra with this Enterprise. Everything was great, perfect organization and spectacular visit. The views of Granada from there are breathtaking. 100% recommended.

title: Guide to the Alhambra
text: We travelled from Salamanca to get to know the Alhambra and it was a very good decision, the visit we enjoyed very much, incredible experience

title: Alhambra
text: I went with my partner on a guided tour of the Alhambra and the experience was fantastic. The guide made the visit very enjoyable, you could see that it knew a lot and also told it in a way that was easy to follow and interesting. The tour was very well organized, unhurried, and we could enjoy every corner. It was a perfect plan as a couple, we learned a lot and had a great time. Highly recommended!
author: jesusrC7529NH

title: Route through the Alhambra
text: We went to the Alhambra with friends and the experience was brutal. The place impresses a lot and we enjoyed it a lot. Everything was super well organized, no messes, and the guide made it enjoyable and easy to follow. Highly recommended, I would definitely repeat.
author: christianmJ8437QU

title: Visit to the Alhambra
text: I am 19 years old and from Granada, but I have never seen the Alhambra like this. The guided tour I loved, it was a super complete experience. The procedures with the Enterprise were very easy and the guide did great, explaining everything clearly and making it very enjoyable. The truth is that I left with a very good feeling, I totally recommend it.
